C1.rule: F-15, F-30, S2-30, OV-0.3: mean paired A_cascade - A_exact >= -1.0 points and the interval lower bound >= -2.0

C2.rule: the mean absolute difference in spawns per run between A_cascade and A_exact is <= 0.5 on those streams

C3.rule: measured gate multiply-adds per input, A_cascade/A_exact <= 0.20 on F-30, A_cascade/A_exact <= 0.25 on S2-30, A_cascade/A_exact <= 0.25 on F-15

C4.rule: synthetic pool of 500 experts: gate MACs ratio <= 0.05 and gate wall-clock ratio <= 0.5 at B = 64 and B = 1024

G.rule: S1 and S2-5 (too few experts for the cascade): accuracy and expert count bit-identical to the exact gate

decision: C1, C3 and C4 PASS: adopt the cascade as the PhyloMoE default (gate_shortlist=2, gate_fingerprint_k=1, gate_shortlist_min_experts=64), test-first, with the historical entry points pinned.
